Rooms.Name: Under the mudhole
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a small room with a great big opening in the ceiling. From this
opening there's mud dripping down in large lumps. >YUCK<. You can smell the
foul stench of the slimy sediment as you try not to get covered by the falling
sludge. To the east there is an entryway leading out from here and it seems
absolutely impossible to force the muddy decent.

Exits.Description: East. You see nothing of interest.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You never saw such disgusting matter before, it nearly makes you puke.

Rooms.Name: Under the Dark Pit
Rooms.Description:
Nice place you found yourself. You stand in the middle of a room with only
two exits, Up and East. A tall ladder is left here so that you can climb up
through the Pit without the use of a rope.

Exits.Description: Up. You can't see a thing up there, it's way too dark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is funny enough a wooden ladder and, after closer inspection, you
discover it is magically held towards the wall!  You can't, even with your
greatest effort, rock it at ALL!

Rooms.Name: A muddy bend in the sewer system
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in what looks like a bend in the pipe system of the sewer.
The 'floor' is covered completely by mud! This includes covering your legs up
to you knees as well. The pipe leads west and south.

Exits.Description:
To the south there's less mud than here! It actually seems to end there! You
have a felling it would be nice to have your feet free from mud again.

You can see a room in which mud drips from the roof onto the floor in great
cakes of sludge. There doesn't seem to be any exits from that room apart from
in you direction.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You never saw such disgusting matter before, it nearly makes you puke.

Rooms.Name: A junction in the sewer pipes
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of what looks like a triple junction of pipes going
east, west and north.

Exits.Description: You can see a mud area starting in that direction.
East. You can't even make out what it might look like, it's just too dark.
West. There's a room with a ladder leading up.

Rooms.Name: Down the old well
Rooms.Description:
You are dangling on the slippery sides of the old well leading down and up.
The only secure point here is the metal bars that are cemented into the sides,
the ones that you cling frantically to so that you don't fall. Who knows how
deep this well is? The bars lead down and up and nowhere else.

Exits.Description:
There's a slight, dim light from above, or maybe it's your imagination. Anyway
it SEEMS darker down here than up there, if that is possible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These look like they're pretty slippery, and not very safe, but perhaps safe
enough for you to climb down, WITH both hands on them.

Rooms.Name: The northwestern corner of the ledge
Rooms.Description:
You stand, swaying out from the ledge, with only a couple of inches of safe,
solid ledge under your feet. The ledge continues to the east but not back
south. It seems that the ledge is too narrow to turn on so you'll have to
continue forward.

Exits.Description: The ledge continues east.
The ledge continues south.
The Abyss lies down there. Who knows what might lurk down there?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks as if it can be opened in a door-like fashion.  Maybe this will lead
the way down.

A small rock sticks out right under it, otherwise the way is DOWN, DOWN, and
SPLAT!!!

This is truly a weird piece of craftsmanship in your eyes.  The edge seems to
form a step leading down, but WHAT a STEP DOWN.  The Abyss opens down there 
leading to seemingly total destruction.

Rooms.Name: The narrow ledge
Rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

Exits.Description: North. The ledge leads into a corner and turns eastward.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling an utterly unknown distance.
South. The ledge leads further south into utter darkness.

Rooms.Description:

The ledge continues further south into darkness.

Exits.Description: North. The ledge leads further north.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.
South. You can just make out the south-western corner of this ledge.

Rooms.Name: The southwestern corner of the ledge
Rooms.Description:
This seems like a ledge that is a little broader than the one just to the
north of here. The ledge seems to lead around some sort of Abyss of total
darkness. The ledge seems to have an odd-looking edge here.

Exits.Description: North. The ledge leads further north.
You see a broad ledge leading eastward.
South of here is the exit from the ledge.
The Abyss lies down there. Who knows what might lurk down there?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks as if it can be opened in a door-like fashion.  Maybe this will lead
the way down.

A small rock sticks out right under it, otherwise the way is DOWN, DOWN, and

This is truly a weird piece of craftsmanship in your eyes.  The edge seems to

Rooms.Name: An odd intersection
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a rather odd intersection of pipes. The pipes actually don't
resemble pipes anymore. They look more like a real stone tunnel, or a
passageway hewn directly into the rock. The ways from here lead north, east and
west.

Exits.Description: North. You see a ledge to something that looks like an abyss.

Rooms.Name: The narrow ledge going east to west
Rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards.

Exits.Description: The ledge leads further east.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.

Rooms.Name: Mid-air
Rooms.Description:
You've just stepped into the most unlucky position in the whole of ELITEMUD.
The result of such a foolish act should be punished with death, you know. With
an acceleration of approximately 9. 82 meters per second per second, you are
now descending the Abyss. What awaits you at the bottom will continue to be a
mystery. Bye Cruel World.

Rooms.Name: The Broad ledge
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a ledge that seems quite a lot larger than the rest of
the ledges. This one leads to the west and the east, plus it has an exit going
to the south. Though you could jump into mid-air, but it probably wouldn't be
such a good idea. The way south is in utter darkness.

Rooms.Name: The northeastern corner of the ledge
Rooms.Description:
You stand, swaying out from the ledge, with only a couple of inches of safe,
solid ledge under your feet. The ledge continues to the west and leads south
from here into darkness.

Exits.Description: The ledge continues west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You can just make out the outline of a trapdoor here in the soil.  The earth
is probably there to conceal a secret entrance.  This looks as if it leads down
into the seemingly solid rock face of the ledge.

The ground here seems a little different from all the other ledges along the
Abyss.  There's a kind of soft soil on this ledge, maybe you should look 
carefully at this.  It seems to be of some interest.

Rooms.Name: The narrow eastern ledge
Rooms.Description:
You are in the progress of walking all the way around the ledge since
there's no way of turning around on this all too narrow path. There IS another
exit from here but that leads right into mid-air and with high probability of a
free fall session afterwards. And THAT is west of here so watch your step.

Exits.Description: The ledge leads further south.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but
darkness. You shiver by the thought of falling that distance.

The ledge leads further south.

You stare into mid-air, and right under there's absolutely nothing but

Rooms.Name: The southeastern corner of the ledge
Rooms.Description:
This seems like a ledge that is a little broader than the one just to the
north of here. The ledge seems to lead around some sort of abyss of total
darkness.

Exits.Description: North of here you can see a ledge.
The ledge leads further west.
The Abyss lies down there. Who knows what might lurk down there?

Rooms.Name: Under the pit
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a completely dark cavern leading west. The wall looks weird
here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: There is a crack here that looks like it has been made recently.

Rooms.Name: Under The Shaft
Rooms.Description:
A ladder leads up from here to the Shaft. A small opening leads west from
here.

Exits.Description: You can see a narrow ledge going north and south.
It's too dark up there.

Rooms.Name: The sewer line
Rooms.Description:
You are in a narrow part of the sewer. Down the sewer continues and to the
north is the ledge.

Exits.Description: You can see the southern part of the ledge.
You look deeper down into the drain.

Rooms.Name: The sewer pipe
Rooms.Description:
You are in an odd sewer pipe You see some odd scratches on the pipe wall, as
from a gigantic rat. You can see some slimy water gently running down into a
sewer drain, and north the drain continues.

Rooms.Name: Mid-air
Rooms.Description:
You've just stepped into the most unlucky position in the whole of DikuMUD.
The result of such a foolish act should be punished with death, you know. With
an acceleration of approximately 9. 82 meters per second per second, you are now
descending the Abyss. What awaits you at the bottom will continue to be a
mystery. Bye Cruel World.

Rooms.Name: The Edge of the Water
Rooms.Description:
The pool side is dimly lit up by your light. You can see absolutely
nothing else nearby. The darkness here seems enormously oppressive here. 
The air is damp and the rock on which you stand is slippery. The pool
seems too dark to make anything clear. The pool seems to extend to the
east. The rock can be climbed upwards from here. 
§N

Mobs.Name: mud monster mudmonster
Mobs.LongDescription: A horrifying Mudmonster is slowly evolving from the mud...
Mobs.Description:
It sure looks like something out of a horror movie.  It strongly resembles
a huge figure made up from mud alone, and it sure looks like it had human 
flesh for breakfast and is strongly intent on having the same for dinner
- Perhaps you?

Mobs.Name: rat
Mobs.LongDescription: The huge hungry-looking sewer rat sits here.

Mobs.Name: beetle
Mobs.LongDescription: The giant, mean-looking earth beetle is here.

Mobs.Name: maggot
Mobs.LongDescription: The giant maggot is here, simply existing.

Mobs.Name: snake
Mobs.LongDescription: The snake slithers towards you. It looks very mean.
